name: iPad
description: Guidelines for traveling with ipad in your luggage.

carryOn.reason: iPads and other tablets are allowed in carry-on bags. You will be asked to remove them from your carrying case and place them in a bin for separate X-ray screening at security.

checkedBag.reason: iPads are allowed in checked baggage, though carrying them in the cabin is highly recommended to protect against theft or damage.

tsa.pageTitle: Can I bring ipad on a plane?

travelTips: iPads and other tablets are allowed in carry-on bags. You will be asked to remove them from your carrying case and place them in a bin for separate X-ray screening at security.

faq.question: Is ipad allowed in carry-on bags?
faq.answer: iPad is allowed in carry-on luggage. iPads and other tablets are allowed in carry-on bags. You will be asked to remove them from your carrying case and place them in a bin for separate X-ray screening at security.

faq.question: Can you pack ipad in checked baggage?
faq.answer: Yes, iPad is allowed in checked bags. iPads are allowed in checked baggage, though carrying them in the cabin is highly recommended to protect against theft or damage.
